collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-06  -  THE STREAM AFTER RAIN SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Heavy rain washes scraps of cloth, broken cord, and discarded containers into a stream used by the village.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Heavy rain washes scraps of cloth, broken cord, and discarded containers into a stream used by the village.

choices.label: Organize a Careful Cleanup Along the Bank.
Trace Where the Discarded Materials Came From.
Ask the Children to Help from Dry Ground.
Discuss Ways to Prevent Another Accumulation.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Volunteers remove much of the debris without disturbing the streambed.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The current remains strong, so the group postpones the deeper cleanup.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The source remains uncertain, but several households improve how they store waste.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The children sort safe, dry materials while adults handle the water's edge.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A teacher turns the work into a lesson about how rain carries objects downhill.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villagers agree to secure loose materials before storms.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The first proposal proves inconvenient, and the group continues searching for a practical solution.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: Villagers discover that poorly secured storage baskets allowed scraps to wash away.
